text:
devon: Hey team — I pushed updates to PR #3422 addressing the comments from yesterday. PTAL when you get a sec. I changed the batching default and added a small config validation.
alex: thanks! leaving quick eyes now. did you keep the old default in a migration path or just force new behavior?
devon: Good q — I added a migration shim. If old env var present we map to new flag. snippet:
```
# migration
if os.getenv('OLD_BATCH_SIZE'):
  cfg.batch = int(os.getenv('OLD_BATCH_SIZE'))
else:
  cfg.batch = DEFAULT_BATCH
```
maria: skimmed the diff — looks fine to me. only nit: update the comment above the shim to mention backward compat.
devon: done, pushed a follow-up commit with comment update and unit test for migration.
alex: nice. can you squash or keep as separate commits? i'm fine with either but prefer a single commit for the rollback path.
devon: happy to squash. want me to squash into the original PR branch before canary?
luca: FYI canary window is tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT. if you squash, please ping before 09:30 so we can schedule the rollout slot.
devon: will squash and ping by 09:20 tomorrow. also added a small opt-in flag to disable migration for new installs: `--no-migrate`.
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit tests 132 passed, integration smoke prod-sim: ✅
maria: :thumbsup: LGTM pending squash and comment tweak which is already done.
alex: PTAL devon — once you squash i'll give final approve and we can merge into canary staging.
devon: thanks — squashed and pushed. pinging @alex and @maria for final approve. changelog line added.
alex: approved. :shipit:
maria: approved as well. good to roll.
luca: added to canary schedule. will monitor latency for first 30m following deploy, will notify in #incidents if anything spikes.
devon: awesome — thanks everyone. will open a follow-up to track metrics and potential rollback plan just in case.
